Maya Chen: Quick question for the team
what's the weirdest non-food item in your desk drawer? Pics encouraged but not required :eyes:
Jorge Alvarez: Folded subway map from 2008. kept it for nostalgia, no clue why :joy:
Priya Nair: A tiny soldering iron. used once to fix a toy, now it's permanent desk decor.
Samir Patel: Taco-shaped stress ball acting as a paperweight. extremely functional. :taco:
Emma Li: Single chopstick i found when moving offices. now my lucky charm. pic: https://imgur.com/abcd123
Alex Kim: Emergency charger that only fits a Nokia 3310. still powers up the nostalgia battery. :phone:
Maya Chen: Also have a 2010 concert wristband i can't throw away. sentimental clutter :heart:
Priya Nair: 3 rubber bands and a weird coin from Croatia. looks like a tiny frisbee.
Jorge Alvarez: Proof of weirdness: https://imgur.com/xyz987 
old key + fortune cookie slip that says "You will find a pen."
Samir Patel: Mini screwdriver set. once saved my headphones in transit. small hero.
Emma Li: Hypothetical emergency: which do you grab first? i'm taking the wristband for morale boosts
Alex Kim: Screwdriver set or the nokia charger if we're going full-retro survival mode
Maya Chen: This thread is peak office culture. keep the pics and stories coming :laughing:
